summary.zh: 我与通知页面重构：底栏精简为发现、仓库、我，通知移至我的页面右上角；个人页工作台与快捷入口重新整理，并清理相关冗余代码。
summary.en: Refactor of the Profile and Notifications surfaces: the bottom bar is now Explore, Repositories, and Profile, notifications move to the Profile top bar, and related redundant code is removed.

items.zh: 界面：移除通知底部 tab，通知入口改为我的页面右上角铃铛，并保留独立通知页面的原有内容与深链。
items.en: UI: removed the Notifications bottom tab and moved its entry to the Profile top-right bell while keeping the standalone page, content, and deep link.

items.zh: 界面：我的页面移除仓库/动态分段区块，工作台下统一展示下载、离线仓库、浏览历史和设置；页面与工作台均支持合理滚动。
items.en: UI: removed the Profile repos/activity segment and consolidated Downloads, Offline repositories, History, and Settings below the workbench with sensible page and workbench scrolling.

items.zh: 导航：关注者和关注中沿用个人主页弹窗路径；仓库和已标星统计按钮直达首页仓库 tab 的对应子 tab。
items.en: Navigation: Followers and Following reuse the profile popup flow; Repositories and Starred statistics jump to the matching Home repository sub-tab.

items.zh: 整理：删除个人页旧仓库分页/动态加载、设置页重复入口、重复首次加载、无效导航参数和通知页孤立代码；工作台请求增加时序保护。
items.en: Cleanup: removed obsolete Profile repo/activity loading, duplicate Settings entry, duplicate initial loads, dead navigation parameters, and orphaned notification code; workbench requests now ignore stale responses.
